profile.headline: Senior Developer at Groups
profile.summary: Experienced Rails, React, and React Native engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed numerous applications in a pair-programming, test-driven environment, taking client projects from dreams to reality
Worked with clients to storycard features and maintain a realistic project timeline
Learned new technologies and contributed to open source projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for shipping integration with EasyPost, managing domestic and international shipping labels across a multitude of carriers, and resolving errors in the shipping process
Worked on an internal, self-documenting api using Grape and Swagger
Improved test suite performance, reducing run time by 70%

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Led code review sessions with the engineering team, to help encourage review and collaboration
Wrote a gem for integrating with the USPS address validation api
Tripled application test coverage
Worked with local coding bootcamp to host coding challenges

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for maintenance of proprietary CMS and main site (www.howcast.com), with over 2 million unique visitors each month
Collaborated with design team and founders to develop and launch e-commerce site offering online courses (www.cakemade.com), integrating with Braintree, PayPal, Vimeo, and Mailchimp 
Designed and built an API and CMS for CakeMade
Spearheaded migration of 30,000 videos to new video CMS
Built a proprietary tool for scheduling video uploads to YouTube, integrating with the YouTube upload, content partner, and content ID apis, and the Ooyala api
